lamps.steady: Seat belt is not fastened. Fasten the belt to turn off the light.
lamps.flashing: Driving 20 km/h or faster with belt unfastened. Fasten belt immediately.

lamps.steady: SRS or seat belt pre-tensioner malfunction. Have the vehicle inspected by a dealer immediately.

lamps.lamp: Parking Brake & Brake Fluid Warning Light
lamps.steady: Parking brake is applied or brake fluid is low. Check fluid level immediately.
ABS system malfunction. Normal braking still works, but seek dealer inspection.

lamps.lamp: Motor Driven Power Steering (MDPS) Warning Light
lamps.steady: Power steering system malfunction. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized dealer.
Emission control system malfunction. Seek dealer inspection to avoid potential catalytic converter damage.
Alternator or electrical charging system failure. Stop safely and check the drive belt.
Low engine oil pressure. Stop safely, check oil level, and add oil if necessary.
Coolant temperature is above 120°C. Stop safely and allow engine to cool down.
Fuel tank is nearly empty. Add fuel as soon as possible.
ESC system malfunction. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized dealer.
lamps.flashing: The ESC system is currently operating to stabilize the vehicle.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Stability Control (ESC) OFF Indicator Light
lamps.steady: The ESC system has been deactivated by the driver.
System detected the key properly; the engine can now be started.
lamps.flashing: Immobilizer system malfunction. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized dealer.

lamps.steady: Smart key detected or not detected. If it fails to detect, see dealer.
lamps.flashing: Smart key battery is weak or key is missing. Start engine by pressing button with key.

lamps.steady: System malfunction if light stays on without blinking. See a dealer.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when signaling a turn. Rapid blinking indicates a burned-out bulb.

lamps.steady: Headlights are in high beam or flash-to-pass position.
Parking lights or headlights are currently turned on.
The Cruise Control system is enabled.
Malfunction in TPMS or lighting systems. Check cluster display for specific details.
The cruise control target speed has been set.

lamps.flashing: Smart key is not in the vehicle while the ignition is on.

lamps.steady: Clutch temperature is too high. Stop safely and allow the clutch to cool.
lamps.flashing: Clutch temperature is rising continuously. Stop and let the transmission cool.

lamps.steady: One or more tyres are significantly underinflated. Check and adjust tyre pressure.
lamps.flashing: TPMS malfunction. Blinks for 60 seconds then stays on. See dealer.

lamps.steady: Soot accumulation is high. Drive over 80 km/h for 30 minutes to clear.
lamps.flashing: GPF system error. Have the system checked by an authorized dealer.
CNG system error, sensor error, or fuel lid is open. See dealer.

lamps.lamp: Low Fuel level warning light - CNG
lamps.steady: CNG fuel tank is nearly empty. Refill the tank.
